description: Free. Get an ingest job started by `transcribe` or `add_sources`. Maps to GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}. Poll every 10–30 s until `status` is completed, partial or failed (terminal). `completed` means every accepted video is transcribed and indexed, so the collection is queryable; `partial` means some videos failed and were credited back (`credited_usd`); `videos.completed` / `videos.failed` count progress. Works with an API key or the collection's `ct_` token as the bearer. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.
name: get_status
title: Get an ingest job
